storage_destination_safety.destination: Use fresh non-worktree scratch or storage directories for --dest; existing matching archival copies and the exact export receipt may be reused under the helper guards.
storage_destination_safety.foreign_worktree_guard: Restore/export/clean reject, at foreign destination ancestors and during payload traversal, nonempty .git directories and .git files, symlinks or other nonregular markers. Empty .git directories contain no index and are ignored (including the managed environment empty /tmp/.git and /workspace/.git sentinels). The helper source ROOT .git is allowed; source-root-subtree operations use its own index rather than treating outer ancestors as foreign, while nested worktrees are refused. Read-only verify keeps safe traversal and byte checks without this foreign-worktree mutation refusal.
storage_destination_safety.concurrency_limit: Keep destination directories and repository indexes quiescent throughout each operation. Do not initialize a repository concurrently; marker checks are not an adversarial-concurrency guarantee.
